_: The National Capital Region as a list of districts, and the CPCB city names that report from inside each one. A GEOGRAPHY, not a reading: it changes when the NCR Planning Board changes the region's constituents and at no other time, which is why it is committed by hand and carries no fetch job. The district list is copied from the Board's own page; the city-to-district mapping is Swechha's, from each CPCB station's own address in data/air-india.json. A city this file does not name is outside NCR, never assumed inside it.
authority: National Capital Region Planning Board, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

source.title: NCR Constituent Areas
source.note: Whole of NCT Delhi; fourteen Haryana districts; eight Uttar Pradesh districts; two Rajasthan districts; about 55,083 sq km in all.

districts.note: Bhiwadi and Khairthal are mapped to Alwar, the district the Board lists; Rajasthan has since redrawn districts in this area, and the Board's list is what defines NCR here.
